create_grpo_trainer: create a GRPOTrainer instance with a model, reward functions, and training dataset for RLHF fine-tuning
configure_grpo_training: configure GRPO training with GRPOConfig specifying temperature, epsilon, beta, and loss type parameters
run_grpo_training_loop: run the GRPO training loop that generates completions, computes rewards, and updates the policy model
calculate_group_rewards: calculate group-relative rewards from multiple reward functions and normalize advantages per prompt group
compute_grpo_loss: compute the GRPO loss with clipped probability ratios, KL divergence penalty, and reference model logprobs
